def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    blocks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in blocks); r1 = max(r for r, c in blocks)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in blocks); c1 = max(c for r, c in blocks)
    kr0 = min(r for r, c in marks); kr1 = max(r for r, c in marks)
    kc0 = min(c for r, c in marks); kc1 = max(c for r, c in marks)
    key = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(kc0, kc1 + 1)] for r in range(kr0, kr1 + 1)]
    rotated = [list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    scale_r = (r1 - r0 + 1) // len(rotated)
    scale_c = (c1 - c0 + 1) // len(rotated[0])
    for r, c in blocks:
        rr = (r - r0) // scale_r
        cc = (c - c0) // scale_c
        out[r][c] = rotated[rr][cc]
    return out

def parse(s):
    return [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
